messages:
hazel: FYI canary started showing a bad tail regression after the node image bump (driver micro-update). p95/p99 jumping on long-context runs.

tyler: numbers? which pool?

hazel: single dedicated-staging a100 pool. median ~22ms -> 27ms, p95 120ms -> 340ms, p99s spiking secs on 8k tokens. reproducible on replay.

ci-bot: perf/latency-check failed on staging-canary: p99_latency increase > 2x (run: 1829991100)

maria: the rollout was supposed to be gated. do we know what changed in the image?

hazel: node base moved driver 520.56 -> 520.79. also tiny PyTorch micro bump but Triton pinned. I profiled KV cache path, looks like memcpy/lock waiting.

frank: can you paste the trace snippet? maybe memcpy scheduling changed in the driver.

hazel: snippet from async profile: 
```
KVCache::insert_range
  -> gpu_memcpy_async
  -> cudaMemcpyAsync
  -> cuStreamWaitEvent
  -> std::mutex::lock (queue)
```

frank: that chain smells like stream/event ordering changed; overlaps are getting serialized. did you run the KV microbench?

hazel: ran kv-cache-heavy microbench: throughput down ~15% and tails worse for seq > 4k. replay command: 
```
python replay.py --model redwood/open-16k --seq 8192 --batch 1 --profile
```

tyler: quick test: try CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to see if sync points are to blame.

hazel: tried it — tail improves (p99 ~130ms) but median suffers. points to ordering/overlap regression.

maria: I'll spin a canary with the old node image and compare telemetry. if it reverts we're blocking the rollout.

devops-bot: deployment scheduled: staging-dedicated -> rwinf/base:2024-04-12-driver-520-56 (rollout id r-10239)

hazel: opened PR #4018 to pin the driver in infra and added a kv-cache microbench regression test to the release checklist.

frank: if revert fixes, we should file a vendor bug with reduced repro + nvprof/cupti traces. Might be a memcpy scheduling internal change.

hazel: assembling nvprof traces and a minimized repro, will attach to the vendor report and post link here.

maria: update: canary with old image looks back to baseline. rolling back staging driver now. marking release rollout-blocker until root cause.

tyler: agreed — block rollout and notify infra leads. thanks. :thumbsup:

hazel: next actions: 1) collect full nvprof + cupti captures 2) try Triton/driver flags (async memcpy hints) as workaround 3) file vendor issue with repro and traces. I'll post artifacts in #eng-runtime once uploaded.

ci-bot: perf suite rerun queued (priority: high). will report when done.

maria: keeping this thread for updates; do not resume prod rollout until we have either vendor fix or a validated config workaround.

hazel: uploaded nvprof zip and reduced repro to the triage ticket, link in #eng-runtime shortly.
